rules.title: An Act petition for a special law authorizing the city of Boston to implement rent stabilization and tenant eviction protections (H.3744)
rules.requirement: Home rule petition that would authorize the city of Boston to implement rent stabilization. The page gives no bill text, so no cap or formula is stated.
rules.status_basis: Bill history shows referral to the Housing committee, a hearing, and on 9/9/2024 the bill was accompanied by a study order (H5035); no enactment is shown.
